text: Ironvale Athletic takes a free kick from near the center circle, deep in their own half. The ball moves quickly forward on the right side, passing from Teo Quinlan to Jonah Lindqvist, then across the right flank to Oskar Lindgren near the edge of the penalty area. Lindgren sends a sharp through ball into the box, and Lindqvist breaks through the defenders to shoot with his foot from about 3.7 metres out on the right side inside the penalty area. The ball goes into the net behind the goalkeeper, putting Ironvale Athletic ahead 2-1 at the Redmond Rovers goal end [#1153] [#1154] [#1155] [#1156] [#1157].
